name: B10-0028/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to keep giving Ukraine money, weapons and humanitarian aid. It asks them to send weapons faster, to stop buying Russian oil and gas, and to agree new sanctions on Russia. It also asks Hungary to stop blocking aid and to restore shelter for Ukrainian refugees. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks countries to give more military aid faster; nothing changes automatically.
- Hungary is urged to end its veto on aid money and restore refugee shelter.
- The Parliament wants a full ban on Russian gas, oil and other imports.
